persistence_and_recursion.reason: The whole-package acceptance already binds tested head acd3821 and its merge-ref CI. A later commit merely persists that historical decision while adding a new design candidate; it must not claim that acd3821 contained its own acceptance record.
persistence_and_recursion.successor_rule: The combined closure-persistence/architecture-freeze head needs fresh four-job CI and a separate Architect decision for the VPKB-001 architecture freeze. That decision does not reopen or recursively re-prove VPKB-000 unless VPKB-000 bytes or its accepted limitations change.
persistence_and_recursion.why_not_two_commits: A separate metadata-only closure commit would create an extra head and extra exact-head CI cycle without strengthening the already completed acd3821 decision. One bounded commit is clearer if the manifest partitions closure-history files from new VPKB-001 design files.
